## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue when applicable.

## Verification

List the relevant checks and their results. For UI changes, include English,
Japanese, narrow-screen and keyboard verification. For data changes, include
source, effective dates, units, continuity decisions and coverage impact.

## Limitations

Describe relevant data gaps, estimates, compatibility or operational constraints.

- [ ] The change is focused and the staged diff has been reviewed.
- [ ] Applicable checks pass, or failures are explained above.
- [ ] No credentials, private working notes or unrelated generated files are included.
- [ ] Data changes preserve source evidence, basket identities and unit semantics.
- [ ] Durable documentation is updated where behavior or requirements changed.
